messages:
Anya: Heads-up: small-batch decode latencies spiked after the segmented-attn fusion landed on main. Prefill looks fine. Observed in prod on node-pool-c4. :eyes:
Devon: Saw same on canary this morning. Any quick traces?
Anya: I grabbed a short nvprof + kernel selection log. Decode requests with seq_len=8 are picking FlashVariantB (the fused segmented kernel) instead of the previous small-decode path. Prefill still picks the prefill-optimized kernel.
Devon: Interesting — so it's a decode-only regression. Do we have kvcache telemetry for those requests?
Anya: Yes. kvcache hit-rate for that cohort dropped from ~87% -> ~45% after the fusion. Suspect the fused kernel changed page alignment/stride so the runtime misses prefix cache lookup.
perf-bot: nightly-microbench: decode_small p50=42ms p95=110ms p99=198ms (+28% p99 vs baseline). prefill p99 +3%. Full artifact: https://perf.internal/2134
Lyla: If kvcache miss rate jumped that much, that would blow up token-cost. Does the fused kernel reformat KV pages (tile size change) or use a different layout?
Miguel: Likely tile size or interleaving changed. If the kernel expects kv pages packed differently we won't hit exact-key lookups and fallback to recompute.
Devon: Repro steps I used locally:
```
./bench --mode=decode --batch=2 --seq=8 --kernel=segfuse 
# warmup 10 iters, sample 100 iters
# nvprof summary: avg_time=45ms, p99=170ms when kvcache cold
```
Anya: My repro (attached):
```
$ ./runtime/profile --trace kernel_select --filter seq=8 --count=200
[TRACE] request=abc123 kernel=FlashVariantB reason=fallback_kv_miss
[TRACE] kvcache.lookup key=(sess,token_prefix_hash=0x1a2b) -> miss (expected page_offset 4096, found 8192)
```
Devon: That log line makes it clear — page_offset mismatch. Kernel expects 8k pages now, runtime produces 4k.
Lyla: Temporary mitigations? Force decode to pick the small-decode kernel until we fix layout.
Anya: Pushed a canary override to pin decode->FlashVariantA for small batches. Canary numbers look promising.
perf-bot: canary-sweep-2134568001: decode_small p99 dropped from 198ms -> 127ms after pinning decode kernel. Throughput recovered ~+22%.
Miguel: Nice. Root cause action items: 1) reconcile kernel-produced kv page format with runtime page builder, 2) add unit test for kv page stride invariants, 3) add a runtime metric for kernel_fallback_reason.
Lyla: I'll open an RFC to update kernel-selection heuristic to include kv_page_stride and layout_compatibility checks. Also propose a tagging metric 'kv_page_layout_version' -> will help rollbacks.
Devon: Also consider compile-time guard: fused kernels should emit a required_layout tag that the runtime verifies before selection (fail early).
Anya: Agreed. I'll own the immediate patchset: (a) pin decode in canary, (b) add a lightweight sampling profiler to catch kv-misaligned fallbacks, (c) add an alert on delta(kv_hit_rate) > 15% within 5m.
Lyla: +1. I'll file the infra tickets and add docs for kernel authors.
Miguel: Also add a small bench in CI that runs microdecode with batch sizes 1..4 and seq 4..32 to catch regressions early.
Anya: Planning a short postmortem + perf-regression review next Wed 10am. @channel please ping if you see unexplained decode spikes or canary oddities. :thumbsup:
